headline: Foot of prime ESE at long period — clean but tiny.
today: Long-period ESE on the ideal angle, just not enough of it at barely over a foot. Dawn NW is cross-off so it'll be glassy and rideable for a log on the incoming toward the 9:33 high, then it goes cross-on ENE and softens further. Take it for what it is.

daysToWatch.note: Best of the run — prime ESE to 3ft with offshore-to-light W wind all day. Clean and organized, worth planning around. Shortboard or fish.
Big on the chart at 3.6ft but it's a marginal SSE angle, so expect closed-out junk despite the light morning wind. Size doesn't save a bad angle here.
Prime ESE around 2ft-plus but S wind builds to cross and onshore through the day. Marginal cleanliness — dawn SW cross-off is your only shot.
